requirement: Identify the governing public pair as NCT01822353, The effect of per oral immunotherapy treatment in severe IgE mediated egg, milk and nut allergy in adults: a separate four-page protocol and two-page SAP, both dated 19 October 2012; keep the reference SAP annotation-only.

evidence.text: The protocol cover prints the study title, NCT01822353 and 19 Oct 2012.
The separate SAP cover prints the same study title, NCT01822353 and 19 Oct 2012.

requirement: Describe a prospective, nonrandomized oral-immunotherapy study in adults aged 18-50 years with severe IgE-mediated egg, milk or nut allergy, organized into allergen-specific treatment groups rather than randomized comparative arms.

evidence.text: The summary and subjects sections define a prospective oral-immunotherapy study in 18-50-year-old adults and list egg, milk and nut groups.

requirement: Require confirmation of milk or egg allergy by compatible history, skin-prick testing, allergen-specific IgE and an allergen challenge; before freeze clarify the corresponding confirmation rule for nut allergy because the protocol sentence names only milk and egg.

evidence.text: The protocol explicitly gives history, skin-prick, specific-IgE and challenge confirmation for milk or egg allergy but does not state the parallel nut rule.

requirement: Apply the protocol exclusions for unstable cerebrovascular or heart disease, active autoimmune disease or cancer, beta-blocker use, poorly controlled asthma and FEV1 below 70 percent.

evidence.text: The exclusion-criteria paragraph lists these cardiovascular, autoimmune, cancer, medication and pulmonary restrictions.

requirement: Describe allergen challenge and treatment as supervised escalating exposure followed by continued oral immunotherapy at the highest tolerated maintenance dose through one year, without inventing an absent dose table.

evidence.text: The protocol describes escalating challenge and immunotherapy doses, hospital observation for specified doses, and maintenance at the highest tolerated dose until one year.

requirement: Anchor paired assessments at pre-immunotherapy baseline and one year after starting therapy for spirometry with bronchodilator, exhaled nitric oxide, methacholine challenge and immunologic parameters.

evidence.text: The protocol schedules pulmonary testing and immunologic measurements before treatment and one year after oral immunotherapy starts.

requirement: Before freeze, define the primary endpoint and success criterion for desensitization or increased allergen tolerance, including challenge dose, assessment window and whether egg, milk and nut groups are evaluated separately; do not infer a hierarchy from the terse PDFs.

evidence.text: The aim asks whether desensitization can be achieved but does not operationalize or rank a primary endpoint.
The SAP lists generic descriptive and comparative methods without an endpoint hierarchy.

requirement: Define allergen-specific and component-IgE analytes, units, transformation, lower-limit handling, baseline and one-year pairing and direction of improvement before analysis.

evidence.text: The protocol states that allergen-specific and allergen-component IgE are measured before therapy and at one year but gives no analytic derivation.

requirement: Operationalize spirometry, bronchodilator response, FeNO and methacholine outcomes, including the analysis variable, units, acceptable-test rules, PD20 censoring or limits and baseline-to-one-year change direction.

evidence.text: The protocol names spirometry, bronchodilator, FeNO and methacholine tests and gives diagnostic thresholds, but not analysis derivations.

requirement: Define scoring, analysis windows and hierarchy for quality of life, anxiety and patient-history questionnaire outcomes; do not invent instruments or scoring algorithms absent from the selected protocol.

evidence.text: The protocol says quality of life, anxiety and patient-history data are collected by questionnaires but does not identify instruments or analyses.

requirement: Define the treated efficacy, endpoint-evaluable and safety populations, allergen-group attribution and handling of challenge failures, participants who never start treatment, treatment discontinuation and missing one-year assessment.

evidence.text: The protocol describes eligible subjects, challenge, treatment and one-year testing, but neither document defines analysis populations.

requirement: For each confirmatory endpoint, define population, variable, treatment or within-person contrast, summary measure, timepoint and strategies for dose interruption, permanent discontinuation, rescue medication, asthma-treatment changes, missing outcomes and death.

evidence.text: The protocol supplies treatment and measurement context but no complete estimand or intercurrent-event strategy.

requirement: Summarize all variables using frequencies, means, medians, proportions and standard deviations as appropriate to their measurement scale and distribution.

evidence.text: The SAP prescribes frequencies, means, medians, proportions and standard deviations for all data.

requirement: Analyze paired baseline and one-year IgE and methacholine results with the Wilcoxon signed-rank test, stratified or modeled by the confirmed allergen grouping rather than pooling incompatible outcomes silently.

evidence.text: The SAP explicitly assigns paired IgE and methacholine results to the nonparametric Wilcoxon signed-rank test.

requirement: Use chi-square tests for prespecified categorical comparisons among allergen groups, with an exact-test fallback and category-collapsing rule when expected counts are too small.

evidence.text: The SAP states that comparison of groups is done with chi-square tests but supplies no sparse-cell implementation.

requirement: For other continuous between-group comparisons, prespecify whether the t test or Mann-Whitney test applies, identify the exact two-group contrasts despite three allergen cohorts, and define assumptions, diagnostics and fallback rules.

evidence.text: The SAP names t tests or Mann-Whitney tests for other continuous variables without a selection rule or reconciliation with the three allergen groups.

requirement: Define the confirmatory endpoint family, allergen-group and pairwise-comparison families, multiplicity adjustment and study success rule; do not apply unadjusted P below 0.05 to every endpoint as if each were independently confirmatory.

evidence.text: The SAP declares P less than 0.05 but gives no hierarchy or multiplicity control across many outcomes and groups.

requirement: Specify item-, test- and visit-level missing-data rules for incomplete questionnaires, nonquantifiable IgE, failed pulmonary tests, treatment discontinuation and absent one-year outcomes, with a primary assumption and sensitivity analysis if confirmatory inference is retained.

evidence.text: The protocol requires questionnaires and paired pulmonary and immunologic measurements but neither document addresses missing data.

requirement: Use the prospective ceiling of 90 participants, described as 30 each for egg, milk and nut cohorts, while flagging the protocol's contradictory reference to four groups and the absence of a power, precision or attrition calculation; never substitute registry actual enrollment 23.

evidence.text: The subjects section says up to 90 and four different groups, then lists only three groups of 30 across pages 2-3; no formal calculation follows.

requirement: Define collection windows, severity and relatedness grading, denominators and summaries for challenge and immunotherapy reactions, emergency-medication use, asthma exacerbation, dose interruption and treatment discontinuation.

evidence.text: The protocol requires hospital observation and prescribes antihistamine, prednisolone, epinephrine and bronchodilator rescue, but neither document supplies a safety-analysis plan.

requirement: Report estimand-aligned effects and confidence intervals for paired and between-group analyses, including median paired change or rank effect for Wilcoxon, risk or proportion contrasts for categorical outcomes and mean or location contrasts for continuous outcomes.

evidence.text: The SAP lists tests and a P-value threshold but no effect measures or confidence intervals.

requirement: Use SPSS 19.0 if reproducing the reference and before freeze specify reproducible procedures, two-sided confidence levels, exact small-sample options, diagnostic rules, data cutoff, tables and listings and independent quality control; leave unresolved choices explicit.

evidence.text: The SAP names SPSS 19.0 and P less than 0.05 but omits reproducible procedures, interval level and quality-control details.
